2014_spells.power-word-heal.effectSummar: Make a target charmed until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.power-word-heal.fullDescript: Using 1 action, a wave of healing energy washes over the creature you touch. The target regains all its hit points; If the creature is charmed, frightened, paralyzed, stunned, or stunned, the condition ends. If the creature is charmed, frightened, paralyzed, stunned, or stunned, the condition ends.
